title: 第687章 提交报告第686章 潜意识的浮光掠影
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
殷哲的这个提醒，让龙涛再次感到一阵兴奋。
事实上，新弟子在进入宗门后，除了引气炼体之外，最重要的课程并不是炼丹画符或者炼器，而是教导弟子们在修仙界，甚至凡间江湖的生存法则。
而其中有一条被反复强调的事情，就是永远不要完全相信自己的记忆。
因为这世上有太多能够影响认知和记忆的法术神通了，甚至有时候都不需要法术，一些凡人都会用的话术和把戏，也能够产生影响记忆和认知的效果。
所以长老们总是不厌其烦地叮嘱：在外面的时候，一旦发现有什么不对劲，比如某些东西和记忆里对不上，或者在陌生地方生出莫名的既视感，都必须立刻警惕起来，很可能你已经在不知不觉中着了道。
而如今有了这个东西，龙涛感觉自己又稳了，只要定期检查日记上的记录，加上自己强大的神魂，只要不碰上真正的大能亲自出手，寻常的认知干扰手段恐怕很难在他身上生效。
不过殷哲在离开之前，还是提醒自己，任何法宝都不是无敌的，千万不要因此就盲目大意，总之……这个法宝日记本，最好还是当作一个辅助道具，也不要真的完全依赖。
龙涛表示会注意后，便回到屋内，打算再好好研究一下。
现在的优先事项，除了报告外，还要好好测试一下这本日记了，首先最简单的，它的上限字数是多少。
龙涛昨天数了一下，这书总共有三十六张纸，说真的，按照它之前的那个记录方式，在家的话还好，一旦出门，特别还是去热闹地方的话，恐怕一天不到就要写满了。
然而当他翻开后，却发现昨天已经快写满的第一页，此刻却变得空白一片了。
他心里咯噔一下，难道这日记……真的就是“日记”，只能记一天，第二天就自动清空了？
正当他脑子转着“昨天的记录跑哪儿去了”的时候，那片空白的纸上，字迹又慢慢浮了出来。他定睛一看，还是昨天那些内容。
他试了试在心里想着“今天”，果然字迹又消失了。
原来如此，龙涛顿时感觉自己肤浅了，这毕竟也是个法宝啊，他竟然如此看轻人家，想着一天不到就会写满之类的。
不过等记录的时间一长，就不能用“昨天”“今天”之类的模糊指令来“翻页”了，肯定得是具体的日期，于是他再次在脑海中想着昨天的日期，结果却没有反应。
他想了想，大概是单有月和日还不够，还需要年份才行。
九霞界一般采用两种纪年法，一个是以明德朝建国为开端的明德历，四千多年了。
还有一个就是以当初天缺关补天军正式建军为元年的补天历，这也是无周天各地最通用的一种公历，哪怕玄秦神朝那种霸道的皇朝，也是承认的，并且这个历法也有一万多年了。
龙涛想了下，还是在脑中以补天历为基础，把具体的年月日都补了出来。这一次，字迹果然又浮现出来了。

这也让龙涛暂时搞懂了“翻页”的方法，要不然就是简单的想着昨天今天前天之类的，要不然就得以具体的年月日为基准。
但这也说明了，这个日记能记录的时间，起码是超过一年的，不然只要月和日就够了，没必要加上年份。
至于到底能存多久、会不会有上限，那只能等以后慢慢试了。不过这东西确实是个极好用的法宝，特别是对于自己这个“公务员”，相当于多了一个小秘书啊。
谁知刚浮现出这个想法，空间袋中的“淆”又不开心了，不停向他传来不满的意思，似乎很不满意他又找了个新法宝。
没法子，龙涛只能在写报告之前，花了些时间帮剑灵擦拭剑身，才让它消气。
……
第二天晚上，主峰大殿内，某个会议室。
除了龙涛外，房间里还有十人，除了宗主和石曼羽外，其余都是能到场的元婴真君了。
而所有人来此的目的，自然只有一个，看龙涛的报告。
content_en:
Yin Zhe's reminder made Long Tao feel excited again.
In fact, after new disciples enter the sect, in addition to entraining qi and refining the body, the most important course is not to refine elixirs, draw talismans or refine weapons, but to teach disciples the rules of survival in the world of immortality and even the world of mortals.
One of the things that has been repeatedly emphasized is to never completely trust your own memory.
Because there are so many magical powers in this world that can affect cognition and memory. Sometimes, even without the need for spells, some words and tricks that mortals can use can also have the effect of affecting memory and cognition.
Therefore, the elders always take the trouble to remind you: When you are outside, if you find something wrong, such as something that does not match your memory, or you have an inexplicable sense of déjà vu in a strange place, you must be alert immediately. It is very likely that you have fallen into the trap without knowing it.
But now that he has this thing, Long Tao feels that he is stable again. As long as he regularly checks the records in the diary, coupled with his powerful soul, as long as he does not encounter a real powerful person who personally takes action, it is difficult for ordinary cognitive interference methods to be effective on him.
However, before Yin Zhe left, he reminded himself that no magic weapon is invincible, so don't be blind and careless because of this. In short... this magic weapon diary is best used as an auxiliary prop, and don't really rely on it completely.
After Long Tao said he would pay attention, he returned to the house and planned to study it carefully.
The priority now, in addition to the report, is to test this diary. The first and simplest thing is what is the upper limit of the word count.
Long Tao counted it yesterday and found that this book has a total of thirty-six pages. To be honest, according to the previous recording method, it is fine at home. Once I go out, especially if I go to a busy place, I am afraid it will be filled up in less than a day.
However, when he opened it, he found that the first page, which was almost full yesterday, was now blank.
His heart skipped a beat. Could it be that this diary... was really a "diary" that could only be recorded for one day and would be automatically cleared the next day?
Just as his mind was thinking "Where did yesterday's record go?", the handwriting slowly appeared on the blank paper again. He took a closer look and saw that it was still the same content as yesterday.
He tried thinking "today" in his mind, and sure enough, the writing disappeared again.
It turns out that was the case. Long Tao suddenly felt that he was superficial. This was a magic weapon after all. He actually looked down on others so much, thinking that it would be filled up in less than a day.
However, as the recording time increased, he could no longer use vague instructions such as "yesterday" and "today" to "turn the page". It had to be a specific date, so he thought about yesterday's date in his mind again, but there was no response.
He thought for a while and realized that it was probably not enough to have the month and day alone, but also needed the year.
Jiuxiajie generally adopts two chronological systems. One is the Mingde calendar which started with the founding of the Mingde Dynasty and lasted for more than 4,000 years.
Another one is the Moutian Calendar, which takes the first year of the official founding of the Tianqueguan Muting Army as the first year. This is also the most common Gregorian calendar in all parts of Wuzhou. Even the overbearing dynasty like the Xuan Qin Dynasty recognizes it, and this calendar has been around for more than 10,000 years.
Long Tao thought about it for a moment, and then used the mending calendar as the basis to fill in the specific years, months and days in his mind. This time, the handwriting really appeared again.
This also allowed Long Tao to temporarily understand the method of "turning the page", otherwise he would simply think about yesterday, today, the day before yesterday, etc., or else he would use the specific year, month and day as the basis.
But this also shows that the time that this diary can record must be at least more than one year. Otherwise, only the month and day would be enough, and there is no need to add the year.
As for how long it can be saved and whether there is an upper limit, we can only wait and try it out later. But this thing is indeed a very useful magic weapon, especially for self-As a "civil servant", I am equivalent to having an extra secretary.
Unexpectedly, as soon as this idea came to mind, the "confusion" in the space bag became unhappy again, and kept sending dissatisfaction messages to him. It seemed that he was very dissatisfied that he had found a new magic weapon.
There was no other way, so Long Tao could only spend some time wiping the blade of the sword spirit to calm it down before writing the report.
…
The next night, there was a conference room in the main peak hall.
In addition to Long Tao, there were ten people in the room. Except for the sect leader and Shi Manyu, the rest were all Nascent Soul Lords who could be present.
Naturally, everyone has only one purpose for coming here, which is to read Long Tao's report.
